It serves as proof that a certain amount of tax has been withheld from payments made to a taxpayer, typically for income payments. This form is used by taxpayers to claim tax credits against their income tax liability when filing their annual income tax return. It is important for ensuring that the taxpayer receives credit for taxes already paid through withholding, thereby reducing their overall tax due [S4].
